body:
The lack of a `POSITION` output is already tracked by https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/10868.
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/97845 is already open which adds most missing inputs and outputs, but misses a few and needs some work.

While we should definitely add the missing inputs and outputs, the visual shader editor doesn't actually have or promise feature parity (see [here](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/shaders/visual_shaders.html#using-visualshaders)). So strictly speaking this isn't a bug, and should instead be tracked with a [proposal](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues). As such I'm closing this issue in favor of a proposal.

In the meantime, I believe you can use an Expression visual shader node to use any of the missing shader built-ins. Note that you'll need to connect the expression node to one of your shader outputs so it compiles, and you may need to use a "passthrough" in the expression node like shown in https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/10868#issuecomment-2394743945.
